name: jumping-frog
description: Jumping Frog: a hand-drawn kids game. Slingshot a frog across lily pads to the flag.

scripts.build:www: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp -R fonts www/fonts && cp node_modules/@capacitor/core/dist/capacitor.js www/capacitor.js && sed 's#<script>#<script src="capacitor.js"></script>\n<script>#' index.html > www/index.html
scripts.sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
